title: MediRush
tagline: AI-driven, private, mobile-first, emergency-ready decentralized healthcare data system
description: MediRush is a decentralized healthcare platform that empowers patients with secure, verifiable medical data using Web3 technologies like zero-knowledge proofs (ZK proofs), AI, and NFC/QR interactions to tackle fatal medical errors, emergency room delays, rampant fraud, and inaccessible research data. By leveraging ZK proofs for trusted onboarding and an AI-driven verification system, it ensures only qualified users access the platform. NFC taps provide real-time emergency access to encrypted patient histories, safeguarded by dynamic hash layers accessible only by the patient, while mobile apps and QR scans enable a seamless, trustworthy user flow—even offline. Future aspirations include a Data-DAO marketplace, where users can opt to sell their data anonymously to doctors or research firms
how_its_made: MediRush leverages MoPro and zkPDF for mobile proof generation alongside NFC taps for seamless interactions, instilling trust in physical encounters, all powered by a Flutter app for intuitive user flows. It utilizes the Hedera blockchain for smart contract logic, Walrus for decentralized storage, and the Pyth network for random key generation. AI-powered agents interact via AgentVerse, coordinated through an orchestration layer. A MeTTa-based RAG system stores doctor-patient interactions anonymously, enabling assistance for future doctor consultations. It also features persistent storage for the Hyperon Atomspace.
